ABOUT NESTMATCH

A rental match should work for both sides.

Our free rental planning guides and cost comparison calculator can be used for housing searches anywhere in the United States, for short or long stays. They do not depend on local listing coverage.

NestMatch is a free portfolio demonstration of a two-sided rental marketplace. Renters review homes, landlords review renter profiles, and a connection appears only after both sides independently express interest.

How ranking works

The open scoring model combines price or income fit, location or move timing, housing or profile fit, and a mutual-interest signal. Every candidate shows an overall score and factor-level explanation so the recommendation is understandable.

What this demo is—and is not

The listings and profiles are representative demo data. NestMatch does not publish real addresses, perform screening, accept rent, or contact anyone. Profile details, photos, preferences, and decisions remain on your device.
